Sanaei / 3x-ui Inbound Import

Upload an inbounds backup JSON from your 3x-ui panel and store it as the fallback for a Sanaei panel in the bot.

Admin Token
From bot admin panel → Web Token, or the link sent by the bot.
Target Sanaei Panel
Only Sanaei / 3x-ui panels are shown.
Inbounds Backup File
The JSON exported from your 3x-ui panel (Inbounds → Export, or /panel/api/inbounds/list). Can be an array of inbounds or {"obj":[…]}.
What this does: Stores the inbound list in the bot's database as a fallback. When your Sanaei panel is unreachable, the bot will use this backup to find and serve configs. It does not push anything to your panel.
